input.subject: Cancellation - workspace HG-2291 (UGC Studio) - Harmony Games
input.body:
Hello,

Per your notice of Sep 12 ("Workspace HG-2291: your pilot is ending"), Harmony Games Inc. is cancelling before the Studio plan starts. Please do not start the Studio plan ($1,800/month) on Oct 16, 2025, and do not bill us for workspace HG-2291 (UGC Studio) after the pilot ends on Oct 15, 2025.

Please confirm the cancellation in writing.

Thanks,
Frederick Stone
Co-founder, Harmony Games Inc.
frederick.stone@harmonygames.co

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the pilot and for checking in. We won't be carrying on after the pilot, so no need to line up the next brief. I've sent the written cancellation to billing@paylane.io as the notice asks, so the Studio plan shouldn't start on Oct 16.

Thanks to you and the team,
Frederick

Hi Maren,

Thanks for sending the order form. We've decided not to set up Pro, so please don't start billing on Nov 1. We'll stay on the free seat.

Thanks,
Frederick

Hi Sven,

Thanks for the proposal. We can't cover travel and hotel this year, so we won't be taking part in the Seattle Indie Expo push. Please don't book any flights or hotel for us.

Thanks for thinking of us,
Frederick

Hi Hana,

Thanks for checking in. Please cancel our Reviewly account before the trial ends: we don't want to move to the Growth plan on Oct 20, and nothing should be billed. Treat this email as our written cancellation.

Thanks for your help,
Frederick

Hi Kofi,

Thanks for the proposal. We won't be booking the November creator campaign, so please don't pencil us in.

Thanks,
Frederick

Hi Rina,

Thanks for the invite and for the call with Robert. We've decided not to take the Dec 5 showcase slot this year, so please offer it to someone else.

Thanks again,
Frederick

Yes, please keep the nightly database backups running. We're staying on, so go ahead and move us to Standard ($19/month) at the Oct 12 renewal.

Thanks,
Frederick

Hi Jonas,

Confirmed: we're staying on. Please renew and reissue the SSL certificate for our game API domain ($89 for the year) before it expires on Oct 20.

Thanks,
Frederick

Hi Dana,

Thanks for the heads-up. We're staying on: please keep us on Team ($29/month from Nov 1) so phone and SMS paging keep working for our on-call rota. No downgrade needed.

Thanks,
Frederick

Thanks for the LOI and for your patience. Because it includes exclusivity, it's going to our lawyers (ESG Law) for review first, and then it's with Leonard or Arthur to sign for Harmony Games. We have your Oct 20 date and we'll be in touch.

Best,
Frederick

Leonard,

The backlog is done. I went by the guardrails doc and your Monday change (travel/event costs count as cash even when a partner books them and bills us). Everyone who was waiting on us got a written answer today, the contacts are in Contacts, and the log is in the Q4 commitments folder: "Q4 commitments log" https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/6a38fe5aaeeb0dad/edit (34 companies).

What we're keeping (Arthur's keep-running list):
- Vaultline: nightly DB backups move to Standard, $19/month, renews Oct 12
- Certwell: SSL cert for the API domain, $89/year, renews Oct 20
- Pingwise: on-call paging stays on Team, $29/month from Nov 1

Waiting on you or Arthur to sign (all on the Harmony Games board To Do list):
Going to ESG first (intake emails sent today, one per agreement, you and Arthur cc'd):
- Kinetic Arcade: Japan/Korea publishing LOI, 12 months' exclusivity. Needed by Oct 20.
- Lumencloud: Startup Program agreement, $25k credits, 36-month term. Needed by Oct 31.
- Bundlehouse: holiday bundle participation agreement, 18-month licence of Domino Delights' name and art. Needed by Nov 1.
- Lanternfly Publishing: SEA publishing for Domino Delights, 2-year exclusive. No date given; they've only sent the deck so far.
No ESG review needed, just an officer:
- Playfuse: mutual NDA on ESG's template. Needed before the Oct 8 call.
- Orbit Store: November featuring agreement, to be accepted in their partner portal. Needed by Oct 24.
- Markward: free-tier click-through terms. No deadline.

For your awareness, the rest:
- Ended: Brightlane, Ascendo, Lingora, Panelpulse, Pixel Harbor Events (booth released before the Oct 10 deposit), Soundvault, Framewell, Wishwave (because of the travel change), Streamcast Talent and Spotlight Fest. Two cancellations were in writing: the Clipforge pilot (to Paylane billing before it rolls into $1,800/month on Oct 16) and the Reviewly trial (before it moves to $79/month on Oct 20).
- Parked for the Jan 5 review: Glyphworks, Quillcraft, Loopnote, Benchmarkly, Driftwood Audio, Tilecast, Echohall, Retainly, Cloudlark, Pressbeam and Hootline. I have a reminder for each on Jan 5. Retainly's trial converts on Jan 12, so that one needs deciding at the review.
- Already answered: Motive Forge (Arthur passed on Sep 19), so we didn't write to them again.
- Left off the log: Nova Rewards withdrew its offer on Sep 23.

Fred
